GOAL: Ground the proposal in the actual artifacts before designing.
READ: listing the agent workspace and parent round directory for SID tables, Issue #126 reference, and any harness docs.
OBSERVED: (pending)
REASONING: (pending)
OPEN: need file names/columns to state exact INPUTS.

GOAL: lock the null model and kill the two degenerate ends before writing the formula.
READ: the task contract (7 numbered clauses + the known Q_H numbers); attempted to read the round dir and this agent dir -- both permission-denied, so the design is derived from the brief alone. No SID table or reference array was inspected.
OBSERVED: (i) a purely size-matched kNN null makes rho=1 for an all-one-bucket level, so the score must mask buckets with n>N/2; (ii) a fully singleton level has no pair weight, so Phi_l must be defined as 0 there, which turns item-ID collapse into a real penalty instead of an invisible level; (iii) at n=2 the construction collapses exactly to rho = d_H(x_i, code partner)/d_H(x_i, NN(i)), i.e. the deep-level term is a direct geodesic test of 'does the finest code merge true nearest neighbours', which is the structure Q_H loses at levels 2-3; (iv) pair-weighting (n_il-1) is derivable from the table and needs no tuned weight.
REASONING: these three fixes (N/2 mask, Phi_l:=0 on empty support, pair weights) make the number interpretable and non-degenerate at both the too-coarse and too-fine ends, and keep it a function of *which* items are co-coded rather than of the bucket-size profile, so it is not a re-expression of bucket count or same-bucket ratio.
EVIDENCE: this record; formula follows in the final record.
OPEN: cost estimate for the chunked distance matrix plus per-item null barycentres at N=24587, d and bucket sizes unknown.

FINAL ANSWER (summary of the record; full text printed in the reply).
METRIC: HSMRE = Hyperbolic Size-Matched Radius Enrichment.
CORE: lift frozen-reference item reps into the curvature -1 Poincare ball with exp_0 (tanh, scale 1/tau or 1/median norm); for each item i and level l take the geodesic Frechet (Karcher) barycentre mu of its code bucket, r_il = d_H(x_i, mu(B_l(i))); compare against the size-matched null r*_il = d_H(x_i, mu of the n_il-1 geodesic nearest neighbours); rho = r/r*, phi = 2rho/(1+rho^2) = sech(ln rho); mask buckets with n<2 or n>N/2; Phi_l = (n_il-1)-weighted mean of phi, Phi_l := 0 on empty support; HSMRE = (1/L) sum_l Phi_l in [0,1], higher better.
WHY: at n=2 it reduces exactly to a geodesic nearest-neighbour test at the deepest code, which is the structure Q_H loses at levels 2-3; it is not an order statistic and not a function of bucket sizes, so it is not a re-expression of bucket count or same-bucket ratio.
COST: blocked Gram 7.7e10 flops + 3e9 flops of Karcher flow, ~30-50 s, <0.5 GB, no sampling, no fitted constant (only c=1, alpha from tau/median, I=20 convergence, N/2 mask from item count).
WORST CASE: index-hash codes (i mod 256, ...), which fool bucket count and same-bucket ratio but give large rho, small phi, HSMRE near floor; and the fully degenerate all-one-bucket or all-singleton table, HSMRE = 0.
OPEN: residual risk that heavy-tailed reference norms push points to the boundary and saturate phi at 1 (guarded by clipping and a q_95 fallback), and that uniform level averaging under-credits tables with padded constant columns.
